scenes.summary: You wake from your dream and learn that the Xiranite Nexus has been fully calibrated. Even better, Zhuang Fangyi brings good news — Arcane has just awakened.

lines.text: And here's even better news — Arcane's awake.
Endmin, are you alright?
What did you dream of?
The tuning has been successful. Its capacity for Originium energy proves flawless.
Once the Proxy arrives, it might become the mighty weapon we need to seal the Very Large Rift.
She wants to tell us something in person. Chen is already off to talk to her.
Endmin, if you're ready, we should head to the Main Pillar as well.
I'm okay... I just had a dream.
Maybe I'm a little tired.
Let's talk about the dream later. How goes the Xiranite Nexus?
Sounds like good news to me.
Let's not keep her waiting.

options: A strange space ... many transport belts, and the suppressor...
A fading shadow ... and the lingering sound of cries and sorrow...

scenes.summary: After waking, Arcane informs you that the Blight in the northern Wuling Exclusion Zone has worsened, and that Nefarith has indeed influenced the Wuling Very Large Rift. Arcane suspects that Ardashir and Nefarith intend to force open the Very Large Rift because of you.

lines.text: Tianshi Zhuang and Endmin. You're here.
Maybe you can get this one to be quiet for a while.
Nagging is caring, okay!
Apologies, Arcane. It was my decision that put you at risk.
None needed. You made the right call, Tianshi Zhuang.
The Originium Arts I've mastered failed to kill him... He's not human anymore.
When I woke, I immediately ordered Summit to share the intel.
I knew it...
They're doing everything they can to open the Very Large Rift. But their target is not Wuling...
...It's you, Endmin.
Thank you. But I prefer less nagging.
Why you — Whatever. I don't argue with patients. I'm just glad you're alright.
Blight Miasma concentrations in the North Wuling Exclusion Zone are spiking. Nefarith's trick has affected the Very Large Rift.

scenes.summary: The rising activity in the Wuling Very Large Rift may be part of the enemy's overt scheme, but every crisis is an opportunity. You choose to act first using the Xiranite Nexus. Though Arcane has only just awakened, she is still the best choice for the vanguard. You prepare to depart for Yinglung Pass.

lines.text: The "truth"...? Was he talking about the Very Large Rift?
An obvious one. The Very Large Rift is increasingly active. We cannot afford to ignore it.
True. If the Xiranite Nexus works as intended, the initiative will be ours.
Once everything is ready, we shall head to the exclusion zone bastion — Yinglung Pass, and go forward with our plans from there.
The Task Force is standing by. I'm formally reporting back —
You just came around! That body of yours needs rest!
Okay, fine. But at least go with us. Don't want you overdoing it again...
My duty is to handle any Exclusion Zone crisis. No one knows the Zone better than me.
Or are you willing to let the Endmin face even greater risks in the North Wuling Exclusion Zone?
Hold on. The Xiranite Nexus is ready?
Yes, while you were unconscious. The Endmin and I completed the Nexus.
There's still room for improvement, but its state is close to the intended design. I'm confident we can use it to suppress the Very Large Rift.
There are others in your Task —
No. I must lead the Task Force myself.
Arcane, I understand how you feel, but certain things shouldn't be rushed...
Tianshi Zhuang, don't you think you've been repeating those words a bit too much over the years?
But this is different. We have Xiranite, and the Endmin...
This could be a rare opportunity...
Very well. Endmin, please take the Xiranite Nexus and go on ahead to Yinglung Pass.
I've been waiting for this day for far too long.
The Very Large Rift and its changes... Are they a trap?
I shall muster our forces at Wuling. The Exclusion Zone is a dangerous place. A larger force is needed to reach the Very Large Rift.
We worked hard to complete the Xiranite Nexus. It shall be well protected.
Let's go, Arcane. It's time we head to Yinglung Pass.

options: But we still have the initiative.
But he doesn't know we have the Xiranite Nexus.

scenes.summary: As you travel toward the exclusion zone bastion, Yinglung Pass, a voice only you can hear suddenly rings out...

lines.text: When Nefarith attacked Wuling, we had to keep the Pass safe and the situation under control. The Yinglung thus sealed this path.
Our vanguards have cleared the areas ahead. We shall carry on as usual.
You're finally here.
Endmin? What is it?
...It's nothing.

scenes.summary: Summit tells you that after the Blight Miasma approached Yinglung Pass, the Proxy went out to trace its source. Arcane has resumed command of the Yinglung Special Task Force and is assigning tasks to everyone. Then, some unexpected enemies suddenly emerge from the Miasma.

lines.text: You're back, Captain! And greetings, my Endfielder friends.
Blight activity has spiked. The Blight Miasma has begun to approach the Pass.
With the wrist cuffs, the Yinglungs will hold out for one to two hours.
Where's the Proxy?
Something happened outside. She went looking for the source of the Miasma.
Understood. I'll take it from here.
Roger, ma'am. All units, command has been transferred to Task Leader Arcane.
As long as I stand, there's no question about that.
All Yinglungs, spread out in teams of three. Set wrist cuffs to hot and execute Action Plan B.
Summit, take two men and run the emergency patrol route, then use sky poles to photograph the Blight Miasma in the Zone.
Yes, ma'am. Holler away if things get messy.
An Yinglung?!
Get back!
Given your current state, you sure about this?
Our primary objective is to contain the Blight Miasma. It must not interfere with the mission.
Wait. What's that over there?
Overflow, sync the Depth readings every minute.

scenes.summary: Si, the mysterious Proxy, has returned to Yinglung Pass. She seems to recognize you. She tells you that dealing with the Blightshades born from the rift is pointless, and that your top priority is to augment the Xiranite Nexus through a ritual. She then presents you with an unexpected "gift" — Ardashir.

lines.text: A small gift for you.
You're late. It's been ten long years.
Lady Si, how are things in the Exclusion Zone?
Not good. The zone is infested with Blightshades.
An unpleasant shadow is only given form by an undesired light. As long as the rift exists, the Æther shall continue to mimic these lost souls.
Your top priority rests still in Xiranite.
I will take that — Yes, the Xiranite Nexus — Hmm. So it's not just memory loss, your reflexes are slower, too.
We meet again, Endmin —
Ardashir definitely has some valuable information...
Hmph. The name is ⟦key|Si⟧. Don't forget it again.
"Blightshades"? Like the Yinglung-looking enemies from earlier?
We must act with haste. I suggest we deploy our Yinglungs at once, push deep into the Zone, and eliminate the Blightshades to clear out a path.
Eliminate? Sounds like a really stupid plan.
Hmm... I have to say that Little Zhuang's really talented... This thing actually works.
I just strolled through the Zone. The Xiranite Nexus probably won't cut it as is. My presence shall remedy that.
I shall prepare a ritual for augmenting the Nexus. Settle your affairs, and meet me later.
Before I forget.
Ardashir...!
Wh-where did you send him?
A prison. Designed by me, strengthened by a thousand taboos of the Scroll. Should be enough to keep the sandy miscreant in.
I just can't stand listening to him talk. It annoys me so much, I can't focus.
Don't worry. The miscreant asked to be bound and won't be able to move. Go ahead if you need to ask him anything.
Agreed. Let me check on Yinglung Pass first, then I'll take the Endmin to the prison.
And you are...
...that little Ink Spirit...?
Huh? Did you just call me an Ink Spirit?!

options: And I was wondering where he went.

scenes.summary: Arcane tells you what the Blightshades really are. Though they look almost identical to the Yinglungs and seniors who were lost, they're just info fragments recreated by the Ætherside. With the Blightshades now attacking Yinglung Pass, she believes Ardashir might be able to provide some useful information.

lines.text: YSTF mission logs.
Li, those enemies... The ones called Blightshades, they're...
Lady Si said he gave himself up, but he might have other plans in mind.
...an Ætherside phenomenon, I believe.
Yes. It wasn't too long after the disaster when the Yinglungs found them.
The Tianshi regard it as random incidents that occur when the Ætherside consumes its victims. They are momentary "information fragments".
Blightshades were usually sighted deep in the Zone. Such incidents were very rare as well.
They only mimicked how the victims acted when they were alive. Like a flashing phantom, they would dissipate in a few minutes to half an hour.
I'd never seen so many Blightshades attacking Yinglung Pass.
It feels as though ... they're trying to escape the Zone...
Precisely why we must extract more intel from that Ardashir.
He manipulated rift phantoms at the Marker Stone and knows how to wield the Æther. He might've had a hand in this.
The Yinglung Special Task Force rarely interrogates prisoners... Most of our enemies aren't people, after all.
But this might be a refreshing experience.

scenes.summary: Ardashir answers all your questions, revealing more about the rift and the Ætherside. But when you ask about the Foundation, he insists that some truths must be witnessed in person. He believes that once you learn the truth, you'll come back to see him.

lines.text: You're finally here.
At last a face I want to see. Many lives I've paid to see you again.
I did not think Nefarith would go to such extremes... Still, I have already reminded you, Endmin.
Are there more questions? Or do you wish to examine my testimonies?
I have one final question...
The ⟦key|Foundation⟧?
The Very Large Rift is so very close, Endministrator.
It shall confound you, then you shall return to me.
I remain faithful, that all dying Universes rely upon your arbitration for survival.
Till we next meet.
You brought destruction to Wuling and pain to my friends.
A full-scale war has not been declared. It isn't too late to change your mind.
I'm the one asking questions.
Ah, forgive my transgressions. Whatever my lord desires to know, I shall present it on a platter of truth.
Ask away.
Our knowledge does not exceed yours. What we did to the Rift was simple... We merely ... "opened" it.
But both you and Nefarith can wield the Æther.
For ten thousand years from Terra to Talos-II, the Terrans also wielded the Originium Arts and developed Originium industry.
But can they truly claim to know the nature of Originium? The answer is negative.
And there is something I must clarify. As a Terran, I was not born with Æther-wielding powers...
Hence, forgive me for my unsatisfactory answer.
Do they remind you of my "tricks" at the Marker Stone? I'm much flattered, Endmin.
The two are indeed alike. Both are "manifestations of Æther energy".
However, those at the Marker Stone were puppets dancing to my strings. These Blightshades are just the victims'...
Enough. Blightshades are just blighted illusions. Don't even think about trying to shake us.
I won't.
She is of a more extreme disposition. Yet strictly speaking, we are both servants of the same Lady.
As for our goal of opening the Very Large Rift, I've withheld nothing from you since the beginning.
We plan to re-create a path into the Ætherside. And you ... will try to stop us.
But I promise you that whatever I said carries no deceit. It is but my sincere wish to make you the lord of all.
Only then will conflicts lose meaning, and mindless violence be gone from sight...
And the price? More victims to fall?
Something that you of the past cannot afford. But you can change, can you not?
Ardashir, a follower of yours in the past.
Unlike fellow comrades who are now history. Cowardly, I sought survival, and found you before the "End" arrived.
Once again I offer you my salutations, Endmin.
No matter. I will not escape. Once you arrive at the Very Large Rift, you will want to see me again.
The secret is not mine to reveal... Memory has left you, but you shall witness and choose. This is how you'll trust me.

options: How much do you know about the Rift and the Ætherside?
What are you and Nefarith planning?

scenes.summary: Si asks for your help in carrying out the ritual to draw forth the Feranmut's power within Yinglung Pass and use it to augment the Xiranite Nexus. To achieve this, you must ignite the altars throughout the pass and activate the Balepyre Towers to focus the Feranmut's power.

lines.text: I must stay at the ⟦key|main altar⟧ to conduct the power of this area, and keep it flowing during the ritual.
Once you return, I shall use the pillar array to imbue the Xiranite Nexus with the ⟦key|focused power⟧, and complete the augmentation.
You'll only need to last till the end of the ritual. It'll be over in a few minutes, and I can handle the rest of the process.
Back already? That means the ritual may begin.
Feranmut Power fluctuations will weaken the defenses and disturb the Blightshades. The process will not be a smooth one.
Take a few hours if you want. Makes no difference.
A little energy and spirit is good. Just be ready.
It's ... uh, an acquaintance of mine taught this process to HAS.
"The eternal night shall be purged by torch, just as Yumen weathered the storms." The ritual is probably inspired by a place named "Yumen".
There, beacon fires were lit at night to provide warning, the flames burning for centuries.
I never been there before, but it must be an incredible city.
Yeah. I wonder where those two are at right now...
Hmph. You really remember nothing...
There are three Balepyre Towers in Yinglung Pass. They are the defenses of the Pass and imbued with Feranmut Powers I left behind.
This ritual will help bring out and direct the energy contained within.
You shall take the Feranmut Power, then ignite the braziers of the array in the proper sequence to activate the Balepyre Tower.
The process will strengthen the power and focus it at one spot.
"Ignite" and "direct"... Sounds like the beacon towers mentioned in the chronicles of Yan.
Hmm... And you are Perlica? The "Supervisor" personally selected by the Endmin?
Ah... Yes, I am Perlica, Supervisor of Endfield Industries.
Perhaps the Endmin did have eyes for talent.
Done with your questioning? Good. Now go.
And you're right. Your task is to — ⟦key|carry on the torch⟧.

options: Can you introduce the ritual to us?
I'm actually unsure how I could help in the ritual.

scenes.summary: After handing over the fully augmented Xiranite Nexus, Si says she will remain at Yinglung Pass to ensure the Blight Miasma does not spread into Wuling City. Before you leave, she also shows her concern in her own way.

lines.text: Good job. I approve.
Once again, the Xiranite Nexus focused yours and my powers. As a piece of high purity Xiranite, it should survive its intended function.
But do not get too adventurous. I... AHEM. Someone might get worried.
Someone must stay here and keep the Blight Miasma away from Wuling, so you can focus on your mission.
Hmhmph.
The North Wuling Exclusion Gate is open. This will be a good time to go.
Is there anyone more qualified than me?
Then we'll be counting on you.
Now this ... is the Yinglung Pass that lives up to its name.
Talk to Arcane and check her preparations for battle. I believe she made some progress.
Wait!
Ahem. Are you just going to turn around and leave? Got nothing to say?
Hmph. Good. Now go.

options: So you're not coming with us?
Things might get easier with your help.
I'll try to recall things about you. Like, right now.
You're beyond the Ink Spirits. I'll keep that in mind.

lines.text: The Xiranite Nexus is ready. The North Wuling Exclusion Gate is open. Once the forces are mustered, we can set off.
I had Summit prepare a few things that might help. You can go talk to him now.
—Some natural minerals can actually exist as gases, and exhibit rather unique properties and functions.
Yinglung has a few tech for processing these mineral gases. Our Task Leader told me to sort and transfer them to you.
We Yinglungs spent years charting this place, and found some useful resources in the Zone.
For our North Wuling Exclusion Zone campaign, the tech will come in useful.

scenes.summary: Wuling City's forces have finished assembling, including several familiar faces. Spirits are high as Arcane and the Endfield Crisis Team form the vanguard, while the others follow closely behind on the march toward the North Wuling Exclusion Zone.

lines.text: Everyone, our main force is now in place.
Yo. We meet again.
Endmin!
HAH! The Very Large Rift and the Science Station! I never knew I'll ever come back.
Maybe this time we'll really get to ... rebuild our home.
Every Watchguard and Tianshi signed up. We had to limit the number of our volunteers.
We drew lots to choose who'd stay behind and protect Wuling. Tianshi Xi Mo is still a little sad about his pull...
So, we shall bring their blessings and hopes with us into the Zone.
We're finally heading back.
Just how did you fall this far...
The Endfield Crisis Team and I shall lead the way.
...Ardashir.
The raft will bring us there. It's faster.
Hm? A powered raft? Here?
Our way into the underground channels of Yinglung Pass.
After the environment of the North Wuling Exclusion Zone worsened, the surface of the EZ has become unsafe.
Can't you see I'm occupied...? What do you want?
Whatever. I shouldn't be hard on an amnesiac. Especially at moments like these.
Go busy yourself with something else. Come back only when you're done.
There are way more things you have not done properly.
And when do you plan to start remembering?

options: Just realized we didn't thank you properly for helping.
Apologies. I've forgotten quite a lot of things.

r: Just realized we didn't thank you properly for helping.
Apologies. I've forgotten quite a lot of things.

lines.text: I told you I'm busy!
Hmm?
Oh?
...Just go already.
Ready?
Then wait for me to lower the Xiranite Nexus and start the ritual.
Do it quickly.
Do not blink.

options: I must take care of something.

r: I must take care of something.

lines.text: Before activating a Balepyre Tower, you must first ignite the three altars linked to it.
The trails in the Pass are unique. If you slip and fall into the gorge, no one can save you.

scenes.summary: Perlica and Zhuang Fangyi hope that, while waiting for the Xiranite Nexus to be tuned, you can rest well and prepare for the next battle.

lines.text: Endmin, you've returned. We verified the details. Our Arsenal Engineers have cleared out some space and started the tests.
Dijiang is literally the largest "Protocol-Originium" of Talos-II. I believe this tuning run will conclude with quick success.
Need me to help with the testing?
You already did back in Wuling. Now, all we need is to wait patiently.
Actually, we asked you back not just for work. There is a personal side to it as well.
Supervisor Perlica made a complaint. Peace has returned to Wuling, but you seem unwilling to take a break...
You know that once the Xiranite Nexus is ready, we will head straight to our next battlefield.
So for now, we want you to take a proper rest under our watch. It is necessary.
Take a good rest, Endmin. We'll see you shortly.

scenes.summary: You go over the intel provided by Ardashir. Perlica explains that the Foundation were thought to be a Precursor organization that should already have been destroyed by you and the heroes of Terra. Although their connection to the Wuling Very Large Rift is unclear, she contacts SOW operators and M3 just in case.

lines.text: From that guy's rantings... our Endmin seems to be related to "the Foundation"?
Perlica, know anything about that?
Perlica?
Oh? Yes, what is it?
Uh, got any clues about that, you know, "Foundation" thing?
The Foundation... According to the earliest records, they appeared on Talos-II during the First Aggeloi War, though only briefly. They were thought to be...
...some Precursor organization.
Wha? Really? The First Aggeloi War?
But, from what I've read, the Foundation should be ... "destroyed" by the Endmin and the heroes of Terra...
Though plenty of Ankhors and Aggeloi remain in the North, the Order of Steel Oath has not discovered other forms of threat.
I'm not sure myself... But we should cover every base. I will notify our SOW operators... and send a message to M3.
Time to focus on the current mission. Let's go and talk to Lady Si and prepare for the ritual.
The existence of the Foundation was not recorded in most mainstream historical records. It is shrouded ... in mystery.
So how is it linked with the Very Large Rift? Wuling and the Aurora in the north are half a planet apart!
Please use this moment to rest, Endmin.
Once the Xiranite Nexus is ready, I'll come and wake you.
The ritual has begun. Go and activate the Balepyre Tower. I must stay here to keep the power flowing.
Don't worry. Wuling is under my protection.
Remember, watch your steps. If you get hurt, you might forget things you shouldn't — again.
Summit has a few things for you. Go and find him.
Have faith in Yinglung technology. They'll be useful in your tour of the Zone.
